exposure: oral misoprostol 50 ug every four hours
oral misoprostol 25 ug every two hours
outcome: unsuccessful induction of labor (vaginal birth after 72 hours)
cohort: The study included 967 full-term pregnant women (>= 37+0 GW) undergoing sequential labor induction using a double-balloon catheter followed by oral misoprostol.
finding: There was no significant difference in caesarean section rates between the 25 ug and 50 ug misoprostol groups; however, the 25 ug group had a higher rate of vaginal deliveries occurring after 72 hours, while the 50 ug group had more neonates requiring transfer to the neonatal department.
mod_finding: The study found no difference in caesarean section rates for the different doses of misoprostol, though the 25 ug group experienced a higher rate of vaginal deliveries occurring after 72 hours.
